review_candidates.title: Network Engineer | Cisco Certified | Global Trading Firm | London
review_candidates.description_excerpt: What you'll do Design, implement and support enterprise LAN, WAN, WLAN and VPN infrastructure Configure and maintain Cisco routing, switching and firewall technologies Support enterprise voice and unified communications platforms, including SIP trunks and Session Border Controllers Monitor, optimise and troubleshoot network performance and availability Deliver infrastructure upgrades, migrations and continuous improvement projects Provide 3rd line support for complex networking and voice issues
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: What we're looking for ✔ Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, ✔ 5+ years' hands-on network engineering experience ✔️ Cisco-Certifications are a must-have ✔ Strong Cisco networking experience (CCNA/CCNP preferred) ✔ Experience with: Cisco Routing & Switching Firewalls LAN/WAN/WLAN VPN BGP & OSPF Multicast VoIP & Unified Communications SIP Trunks & SBCs Wireless Networks ✔ Experience with network monitoring and performance management ✔ Scripting or automation experience (Python, Ansible or similar) would be highly advantageous ✔ Previous financial services experience is beneficial but not essential.
